summary: Jinxin Technology Holding Co filed a Form 6-K announcing the formal appointment of Mr. Jun Jiang as Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Jiang, who previously served as director, COO, and interim CFO, was permanently appointed to the CFO role. The filing is a routine report of an internal management change, not a forced departure. No terms, consideration, or structural details are disclosed. The appointment is effective as of the filing date. This is a standard corporate governance update without special-situation implications; the event is the CFO appointment itself, not a broader strategic or control event.
